{{Top|ca|leg}}
"'''The Courage of Palpatine'''" was a feature exhibit in the [[Hanna Institute of Antiquities/Legends|Hanna Institute of Antiquities]]&mdash;a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] and [[University/Legends|university]] located in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]&mdash;during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The exhibit focused on the bravery<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> then-[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had shown during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the least-visited exhibit in the history of the institute.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
"The Courage of Palpatine" was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
